xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3575: UAT failure parks forever — wire uatStatus=failed into the canonical feedback route like review/test failures

plan.title: UAT failure parks forever — wire uatStatus=failed into the canonical feedback route like review/test failures
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5

narratives.Problem: A failed UAT verdict is recorded durably and then nothing acts on it. setReviewStatus() counts uatStatus='failed' as a merge blocker (src/lib/review-status.ts:292) so the merge gate correctly refuses, but no code path writes a feedback file, messages the work agent, or escalates. The issue lands in the uat-failed parked orbit, whose own copy names the defect: 'nothing routed the failure back to work' (src/lib/parked/resolver.ts:317). Review-blocked, review-failed, test-failed, and CI-failed all have relays; UAT is the only verdict with none.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/cloister/uat-failure-feedback.ts — a relay that writes one feedback file through writeFeedbackFile() (specialist 'uat-agent', outcome 'failed'), resolves the delivery target through resolveIssueFeedbackTarget(), messages a live/resurrected work agent with owesRework:true, and calls surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou() when no target resolves. Fire it from the uatStatus transition inside setReviewStatus(), next to the existing test-failure relay, so all three writers of uatStatus='failed' (the REST status route, `pan admin specialists done uat`, the deacon's unsignaled-verdict replay) are covered by one wiring. Dedup on ReviewStatus.reviewedAtCommit so a re-posted verdict writes one file. Then give the uat-failed parked orbit its new owner semantics: suppress it while a live work agent exists, and correct the orbit and stall-sweeper copy plus the docs that still say nothing routes UAT failures back.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT add a new patrol, cron, timer, or second nudge channel; delivery goes only through writeFeedbackFile(), resolveIssueFeedbackTarget(), surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou(), and messageAgent().
- Do NOT add a new stuckReason flavor; the relay reuses FEEDBACK_DELIVERY_STUCK_REASON via surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou, so scripts/guard-park-exits.sh needs no new copy entry.
- Do NOT post a PR comment on UAT failure (review verdicts do; UAT gets the feedback file and the agent message only).
- Do NOT add an activity-log or TTS entry for uatStatus transitions in setReviewStatus().
- Do NOT add dedupKey keyed delivery or an ambiguous-delivery retry ladder to the UAT relay's messageAgent call.
- Do NOT change readyForMerge or merge-blocker semantics; review-status.ts:292 already blocks the merge gate correctly.
- Do NOT statically import the new relay from src/lib/review-status.ts (circular ESM; dynamic import only).
- Do NOT delete the uat-failed parked orbit; suppress it only while a live work agent exists.
narratives.Testing: Every item carries its own vitest file and is verified with `npx vitest run --configLoader runner <path>` plus `npm run typecheck`. The circular-import invariant is additionally guarded by a static source assertion in the WI-2 test and by `npm run lint:circular`. The parked-orbit change is verified by the existing fixture harness in src/lib/parked/__tests__/resolver.test.ts and by `npm run lint:park-exits`.

autoDecisions.summary: Fire the relay from the uatStatus transition inside setReviewStatus() rather than from the uatStatus branch of POST /api/review/:issueId/status as the issue body suggested.
autoDecisions.rationale: Three callers write uatStatus='failed' — routes/workspaces.ts:1475, routes/specialists/legacy-routes.ts:241-247, and cloister/deacon.ts:1452-1455 — and only the write door sees all three. deliverTestFailureToWorkAgentHostSide (review-status.ts:509-514) already established this pattern for test failures. The issue's route-level acceptance criterion is satisfied transitively because the route calls setReviewStatus at workspaces.ts:1483.

autoDecisions.summary: Dedup on ReviewStatus.reviewedAtCommit held in an in-process Map, cleared on any non-'failed' uatStatus write, instead of fetching a PR head SHA from GitHub.
autoDecisions.rationale: reviewedAtCommit is already snapshotted into the row at workspaces.ts:1466-1469 and is the identity review-verdict-feedback.ts:140-142 uses for the same purpose. Fetching a head SHA would put a `gh` subprocess on a hot write path for no extra precision.

autoDecisions.summary: No dedupKey keyed delivery and no ambiguous-delivery retry ladder on the relay's messageAgent call.
autoDecisions.rationale: The anchor map already guarantees one delivery per verdict. review-verdict-feedback.ts:210-251 needs that ladder because a review cycle re-fires many times per anchor; UAT does not.

autoDecisions.summary: Suppress the uat-failed parked orbit when a live agent with role 'work' exists, rather than deleting the orbit or leaving it unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deleting it loses the signal for the case the relay cannot cover (no resurrectable agent); leaving it unchanged reports a park for an issue an agent is actively reworking. Suppression keeps the orbit meaningful and satisfies the issue's fourth acceptance criterion literally.

autoDecisions.summary: No PR comment, no activity/TTS entry, and no new stuck flavor for UAT failure.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's step 4 forbids a second nudge channel, and each of these is a separable observability change with its own review surface.

items.title: Add the UAT-failure feedback relay module with its unit tests

narrative.Action:
Create src/lib/cloister/uat-failure-feedback.ts exactly as PRD section 4.1 specifies. Exports: UatFailureFeedbackOptions { issueId, uatNotes?, workspacePath?, anchor? }, UatFailureFeedbackResult { feedbackPath?, agentMessageSent, needsYouSurfaced, deduplicated }, relayUatFailureFeedbackPromise(opts), the Effect wrapper relayUatFailureFeedback(opts), clearUatFailureFeedbackAnchor(issueId), and resetUatFailureFeedbackStateForTests(). Body order (PRD 4.1 steps 1-9): uppercase the issue id; return { deduplicated: true } when the module-level Map already holds this issue id with an equal anchor; resolve workspacePath from opts or resolveProjectFromIssueSync like ci-failure-feedback.ts:239-242; call writeFeedbackFile({ specialist: 'uat-agent', outcome: 'failed', summary: 'UAT FAILED: ' + notes.slice(0,80), markdownBody }) through Effect.runPromise and return early WITHOUT recording the anchor when it fails; record the anchor only after a successful write; resolve the target with resolveIssueFeedbackTarget(issueId); on { agentId } send messageAgent(agentId, 'SPECIALIST FEEDBACK: uat-agent reported UAT FAILED for <ID>.

MUST READ: <path>

...', 'internal', { owesRework: true }) and surface needs-you if that call throws; on { needsYou } call surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou(issueId, target.reason, { specialist: 'uat-agent', feedbackPath }). Wrap steps 6-9 in try/catch that only console.warns. Write the test with the vi.hoisted()+vi.mock() door-mock pattern from src/lib/cloister/__tests__/review-verdict-feedback.test.ts:1-38, mocking ../feedback-writer.js, ../feedback-target.js, ../../projects.js, and ../../agents/messaging.js, and calling resetUatFailureFeedbackStateForTests() in beforeEach.
narrative.Notes: 'uat-agent' is already a member of the WriteFeedbackOptions.specialist union at src/lib/cloister/feedback-writer.ts:19 — do not widen that type. No execSync, no timers, no new patrol.

items.title: Given a failed UAT verdict with notes and a target that resolves to { agentId }, the relay calls writeFeedbackFile exactly once with specialist 'uat-agent' and outcome 'failed' and a markdownBody containing the notes, and calls messageAgent once with that agent id, a body containing 'MUST READ:' and the feedback path, and { owesRework: true }.

Given resolveIssueFeedbackTarget returns { needsYou: true, reason }, the relay calls surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou with that reason and { specialist: 'uat-agent', feedbackPath }, never calls messageAgent, and returns needsYouSurfaced: true.
Given a resolved agent whose messageAgent call rejects, the relay surfaces a needs-you trip whose reason contains the agent id and the thrown message, and returns agentMessageSent: false.

Given two relay calls carrying the same anchor, writeFeedbackFile is invoked exactly once and the second call returns deduplicated: true; given a second call carrying a different anchor, writeFeedbackFile is invoked twice.

Given clearUatFailureFeedbackAnchor(issueId) is called between two same-anchor relay calls, writeFeedbackFile is invoked twice; and given writeFeedbackFile returns { success: false }, the relay skips messageAgent and a subsequent identical call still attempts the write.
Fire the UAT relay from the uatStatus transition inside setReviewStatus

expected_outputs: lint:circular exits 0 with no new cycle reported

narrative.Action: In src/lib/review-status.ts, add two module-private helpers next to deliverTestFailureToWorkAgentHostSide (currently at :697): deliverUatFailureToWorkAgentHostSide(issueId, status) which `await import('./cloister/uat-failure-feedback.js')` and calls relayUatFailureFeedbackPromise({ issueId, uatNotes: status.uatNotes, anchor: status.reviewedAtCommit }) inside try/catch that only console.warns; and clearUatFailureAnchorHostSide(issueId) which dynamically imports clearUatFailureFeedbackAnchor. Then, immediately after the existing test-failure block (currently :509-514) and before `return updated;`, add: `if (update.uatStatus === 'failed') { void deliverUatFailureToWorkAgentHostSide(issueId, updated); } else if (update.uatStatus) { void clearUatFailureAnchorHostSide(issueId); }` with the PRD 4.2 comment explaining why the write door and not the route. The fire condition is deliberately NOT a transition guard — the relay's anchor map owns dedup so a second genuine failure on a new commit still delivers. Add the new test file using the harness established by src/lib/__tests__/review-status-reconcile.test.ts, mocking './cloister/uat-failure-feedback.js'.
narrative.Notes: HAZARD H1: src/lib/cloister/feedback-target.ts:266 dynamically imports '../review-status.js'. A STATIC import of the relay from review-status.ts closes a circular ESM cycle that Node 22 strict ESM rejects at dashboard boot, and neither typecheck nor unit tests catch it. Dynamic import only. HAZARD H2: never let the relay throw into setReviewStatus — fire with `void` and swallow in the helper.

items.title: Given setReviewStatus(id, { uatStatus: 'failed', uatNotes: '<text>' }), the mocked relayUatFailureFeedbackPromise is invoked exactly once with issueId and that uatNotes.
Given the review-status row carries reviewedAtCommit, the relay receives that SHA as its anchor argument.
Given setReviewStatus(id, { uatStatus: 'passed' }), clearUatFailureFeedbackAnchor is invoked and relayUatFailureFeedbackPromise is not.
Given a relay that rejects, setReviewStatus still returns a status carrying uatStatus 'failed' and does not throw.
Reading src/lib/review-status.ts as text finds no top-level `import ... from './cloister/uat-failure-feedback.js'` statement, and npm run lint:circular exits 0.
Suppress the uat-failed parked orbit while a live work agent owns the rework

expected_outputs: src/lib/parked/__tests__/resolver.test.ts passes including the extended uat-failed fixture

narrative.Action: In classifyParked() (src/lib/parked/resolver.ts:312-321), compute `const hasLiveWorkAgent = s.liveAgents.some((agent) => agent.role === 'work');` and add `&& !hasLiveWorkAgent` to the uat-failed condition. Rewrite the two copy strings: parkReason becomes 'UAT failed and no work agent is live to rework it — the merge gate will not take the issue and the UAT-failure relay found no delivery target'; unparkCondition becomes 'pan start <id> to put a work agent on the UAT feedback; the relay redelivers on the next failed verdict'. Keep the details payload { uatNotes } unchanged. Extend the existing fixture test at src/lib/parked/__tests__/resolver.test.ts:112-118 to assert both directions, and confirm the orbit-coverage map at :207 still yields a uat-failed row (it passes liveAgents: [], so it should).
narrative.Notes: s.liveAgents is already gathered (resolver.ts:170-171) and AgentState.role is already read in the same function at :370 — no signal-gathering change. HAZARD H4: with uat-failed suppressed, the idle-running orbit (:361-383, fires only when rows.length === 0) can now fire for a work agent idle 6h+ on the same issue; that is the correct 'leaderless' signal, not a regression.

items.title: Given a review status with uatStatus 'failed', mergeStatus not merged, readyForMerge false, and liveAgents containing an agent with role 'work', classifyParked returns no row whose orbit is 'uat-failed'.

Given the same review status with liveAgents empty, classifyParked returns exactly one 'uat-failed' row whose parkReason names the UAT-failure relay finding no delivery target and whose unparkCondition names `pan start`.
The existing orbit-coverage fixture map still produces a uat-failed row for its uat-failed entry, and every PARKED_ORBITS member remains represented.

Update the expected substring in src/lib/cloister/__tests__/stall-sweeper.test.ts:105-106 to match while preserving its uatNotes evidence assertion.
